description: Data breaches announced in the last few days (default 30), newest first, optionally in one country. Returns up to 10 incidents with date, scale, leaked data types, a source link and the Teollimi page.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. KR, US, JP.

days.description: How many days back to look (1-60, default 30).

lang.description: Answer language: ko (Korean), en (English) or ja (Japanese). Defaults to the query's language, else English.

name: recent_breaches
title: List recent data breaches
